concepts.name: Helical Paddle Pin Riser
concepts.mechanism_family: Vertical auger elevator with compliant paddle flights and a top e
concepts.scoring_sequence: Front rollers draw a lying or upright object into the guarded well; rotating helical paddles raise and turn it, then a short top gate directs it onto the Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A central auger-like paddle stack continuously elevates and reorients the object without a carriage, circulating bucket, or belt conveyor.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Approximate paddle pitch, guide clearance, and flange interaction require development; joints and controls are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Inclined Winch Cradle
concepts.mechanism_family: Cable-winch funicular cradle on paired inclined rails
concepts.scoring_sequence: A split front scoop captures the object, the winch pulls its wheeled cradle up straight inclined rails, and a hinged nose plate rolls the object gently onto the selected Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: The loaded cradle climbs a fixed diagonal railway under cable tension, combining lift and forward reach without a vertical mast or curved trolley path.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Cable routing, cradle retention on abrupt motion, and useful rail angle remain unresolved; joints and controls are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Barrel-Cam Carousel Setter
concepts.mechanism_family: Vertical-axis staging carousel with barrel-cam follower saddles
concepts.scoring_sequence: Side rollers feed an object into a radial saddle; carousel rotation indexes it around the column while a cam follower raises that saddle, and a radial pusher completes placement.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Rotation around a shaped central cam simultaneously indexes and elevates individual saddles, providing staged storage and lift without a conventional linear elevator.
concepts.main_uncertainty: The cam profile, follower loading, and reliable retention of both Cup and Pin orientations are only conceptual; joints and controls are not implemented.

concepts.name: Sector-Arm Rim Nest
concepts.mechanism_family: Geared sector shoulder with independently rotating rim nest
concepts.scoring_sequence: A floor-level roller nest centers a Cup or Pin flange, the large geared shoulder sweeps the nest upward, and wrist rotation establishes the desired upright or lying placement attitude.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A broad sector-geared shoulder carries a shallow rim-supporting nest while a coaxial wrist controls orientation independently of the lift arc.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Sector backlash, wrist torque, and retention through the sweep are undetermined with the approximate object geometry; joints and controls are not implemented.

concepts.name: Toggle-Knee Pop-Up Tray
concepts.mechanism_family: Over-center knee linkage with low transfer tray and terminal tip
concepts.scoring_sequence: Counter-rotating front rollers load a low tray; a powered knee unfolds two serial link pairs to raise the tray nearly vertically, then a terminal tipping link meters the object onto the Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A compact folded knee straightens into a tall load-bearing column, gaining height through an over-center serial linkage rather than crossed scissor members or a mast.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Over-center force variation, side stiffness, and safe tray attitude need investigation; joints and controls are not implemented in this static preview.
